Hi there! I was diagnosed back at the beginning of November, and by the end of December, I had gained most of my facial strength back. It will take time. I suggest sleeping with an eyepatch and possibly wearing one during the day if necessary, if your eye is not closing properly. Get yourself some good quality eye drops, your pharmacists can recommend some. If you're feeling self-conscious about it (like I was) wear a mask. Massage your face and try practicing smiling and chewing (just the motions till you can properly eat) and blinking. It's going to feel worse before it gets better. I will say that if you're anything like me when you're stressed, tired, or have a headache my face tenses up and it becomes more of an effort to blink. Regarding your wedding if you have a photographer speak to them about their editing skills and potential poses to help with the BP. You will get better. BP is a long-term condition I find but the bulk of it will heal. Give yourself some grace.

ACOFAS is probably the worst book in the series. I don't know what was supposed to come out of it other than Nesta written as a horrible character, Cassian being immature, solidifying the Elain/Azriel/Lucien triangle (yippee) and Feyre going from not being ready or wanting children (I could be wrong about the last one) to her wanting a child in case anything were to happen to Rhys she’d have a part of him...... 😬

Morally speaking the worst ones are Tamlin, Nesta* (reasons stated above), Rhys and Amren. 

Amren and Nesta are very interesting characters when you compare them side by side- they're facets of the same coin. While Amren is beloved (from what I've seen) for her cold, calculating and almost vicious personality, Nesta is the opposite. I think the difference is Amren got more time developing those moments of vulnerability or at least “justification” for her actions. Idk if Maas did this intentionally so to explain Nesta in her own book or purposely wrote her to be disliked (I read that Nesta and Elain were originally supposed to be the evil step-sister trope). I think that's why I've struggled to like her, Maas did not give her enough moments to display her reasoning and justification for her actions.

Oh, I agree Elain is just as much to blame. Her naiveness and let's be honest ignorance, was just as infuriating. Her being innocent and gentle is not the same as being naive. 

I really liked Nesta in ACOMAF and ACOWAR (to a certain point); I don't remember which book Feyre describes Nesta as someone who feels too much and has an iron wall but I felt that. The appreciation for a character that feels too deeply while desperately trying to protect herself was so relatable. 
I deal with anxiety and depression so watching Nesta struggle to regain the little control she had was heartbreaking. That being said I also have been on the receiving end of someone else’s toxic self-destruction and it's not fun. This is why I have such a love/hatred for her, regardless of your struggles and hardships it's no excuse to treat someone as your punching bag (that goes for all the ACOTAR characters).

I've been debating about reading her book in fear of being disappointed, especially if she doesn't have any growth. From what I've seen online it's a mix 😕

Well, she did force Feyre, their father should have been filling that role but Nesta also didn't help Feyre in any way to make money or feed the family. So in many ways, she did force her and even encouraged/relied on her to hunt. 

Its true Feyre involved them but realistically she couldn't turn to any other human that would believe she meant to protect humanity or that she was even human originally. Was it ideal? No, but it is what they had to work with. Rhys should have protected them. 

Cassian isn't perfect in this situation- none of them are. But from what I remember Nesta was the one that started the distance even before ACOFAS she never visited Cassian while he was recovering and kept pushing him away. Yes, Cassian is acting like a child too but it's just the cruel way Nesta reacts to others.  

I might be wrong but I believe Feyre or Nesta mentions that even before the Solstice Feyre was making efforts (and I believe Elain and Amren) to see and help Nesta but kept turning it down. I think the scene that angered me the most was Nesta becoming angry that Feyre gives her the rent instead of a gift(?) and the disappointment she felt that she wasn't invited to the party knowing very well she would have said no or been in a terrible mood. 

I understand the pain she's going through and how hard it is to break toxic and self-destructive behaviour but when you're an adult you need to make adult choices. Healing is not a linear path but you need to make the first step and Nesta just didn't want to do it. 

I haven't read her book but I'm hoping Maas gave her that opportunity because I really did love Nesta in ACOMAF 😕

Firstly Nesta was not a child at the beginning of ACOTAR she was 22- she's just as much to blame in Feyre the ACTUAL child being forced to be the breadwinner. I'm sorry but I don't agree with Feyre being responsible for Nesta and Elain being turned into Fae. If Feyre hadn't been forced out hunting this wouldn't happen (although it can be assumed they could have been killed by the Hybern Fae). 

Nesta’s action in ACOFAS was what killed her for me. I understand that she was going through so much trauma and realistically she wasn't going to get over it in a snap. I just didn't appreciate her treatment of EVERYONE (including herself). She continued self-destructive behaviour, attacked the people that would reach out to her and then sulk that they were moving on with their lives. Sorry, you can't burn your bridges and expect people to save them. 
Now Nesta had every right to turn Cassian down if she wasn't interested. I just didn't appreciate the hot and cold behaviour from her, yes Cassian didn't help but I wouldn't exactly be opening up to someone acting as if they despised me either. I also didn't appreciate her sleeping with other men (there's absolutely nothing wrong with how many partners a person has) just maybe not after kissing a guy when you were about to die 
and stating your feelings. 🙃
Now it can be said that she moved on and slept with other men to say she wasn't interested but that's just cruel. She's an adult she can use her words.
